evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting.
evaluations.rationale: No story in the backlog imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule with this requirement; other search-based stories are complementary rather than contradictory.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
evaluations.rationale: This personalization requirement does not conflict with any other story; other recommendation/search stories provide alternative or additional sources rather than incompatible rules.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on other users similar to myself.
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes a contradictory constraint; collaborative-filtering style recommendations coexist with other recommendation sources.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity.
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity based search is not incompatible with other search or recommendation stories in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path.
evaluations.rationale: Using enriched metadata complements other search methods; no story forbids or contradicts this approach.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps.
evaluations.rationale: Making tags available for processing does not conflict with other stories; no incompatible rule about tag handling exists elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to view thumbnail sequences of video segments.
evaluations.rationale: Providing thumbnail sequences does not impose a behavior that contradicts any other story.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids providing similarity info; other similarity stories are complementary.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to get info about perceptually similar video items and segments.
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity requirement does not conflict with other stories; it refines similarity but is not incompatible.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations from similar profiles.
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation from profiles is not contradictory to other recommendation sources; no mutually exclusive rule exists.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area.
evaluations.rationale: News-based recommendations are an additional source and do not conflict with profile- or similarity-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them.

evaluations.evidence: As a user, I want to search content items using automatic speech recognition.
